features.title: Hygienic & Touchless
features.desc: Infrared sensor detects your hand and dispenses the desired amount – completely touch-free. No germs, no drips, no cross-contamination between the three chambers.

features.title: Space-Saving & Tidy
features.desc: One device replaces three separate dispensers or tubes. Ideal for small bathrooms, guest toilets, or minimalist interiors. Less clutter, more aesthetics.

features.title: Sustainable Refill System
features.desc: The 300 ml chambers are refilled via large refill packs (1 L soap, 500 ml foam, 300 ml paste). Less plastic waste, lower carbon footprint, more cost-effective long-term.

features.title: Smart & Customizable
features.desc: Three dosing levels per chamber (0.5–2.0 ml), adjustable via buttons on the device. Optional app control (firmware update Q2 2025): usage stats, refill reminders, guest mode.

features.title: Design That Fits
features.desc: Four color variants (White, Black, Chrome, Matte White), clean lines, matte finishes. Seamlessly integrates into any bathroom design – from hotel-style to Scandi-chic.

features.title: Long Runtime, Fast Charging
features.desc: The 2000 mAh Li-ion battery lasts up to 6 months (at 20 uses/day). USB-C charging in approx. 3 hours. LED status indicator shows charge level.
